note: one declarative source for every storefront verdict supports. read by extension/src/extract/sites.ts, which derives url parsing, review page urls, the content script matches, the bridge allowlist, and the thumbnail host allowlist from it. adding a storefront is an entry here plus a rules file in extension/src/extract/rules, not a code change. imageHosts names the cdn hosts a thumbnail may point at beyond the storefront hosts themselves, and anything else is dropped rather than rendered.
